youtube.title: Pressure Cooker ki Seeti Kya Sach Mein Bajti Hai Khana Pakne Par? 🍲 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Aapke pressure cooker ki seeti ye nahi batati ki khana pak gaya hai. Band dhakkan mein bhaap fansti hai aur pressure badhta hai. Normal hालत mein paani sau degree se zyada garam nahi hota, lekin is pressure mein wo lagbhag ek sau bees degree tak pahunch jaata hai. Isi wajah se dal itni jaldi galti hai.

Seeti ek weight hai jo tabhi uthta hai jab pressure bahut zyada ho jaata hai. Har seeti ka matlab hai ki cooker bhaap bahar nikaal raha hai taaki phat na jaaye. Agli baar seeti gino, to ye yaad rakhna.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
